en: Multiview color postcard showing landmarks of Bucharest, Romania. The front has five panels: the Arcul de Triumf on a tree‑lined boulevard with traffic; the city coat of arms labeled "BUCURESTI"; Mogoșoaia Palace beside a lake with people rowing; the Bucharest Opera House with gardens; and Carol Park with its monumental mausoleum above a bridge and boaters on the lake. The reverse is printed in Romanian and French with address lines, a Romanian stamp (40 bani) marked POSTA ROMANA, and a cancellation from București.
